$comment: Inputs for pipeline:subbasins. A river node is everything upstream (HydroBASINS level-12 NEXT_DOWN) of the polygon holding its river's mouthReach (data/out/rivers.ndjson); below the root, endorheic polygons (ENDO > 0) are left out because they drain to closed depressions, not to the river. An endorheic node holds every endorheic polygon of its parent. The root is the whole basin; a node's own area is its set minus its children's sets, and the own areas must partition the root. level 1 = main tributaries (Phase 4); levels 2-3 come in Phase 6.
